decisions.reason: Adding page numbers to the manuscript does not change the separate requirement to review Table-of-Contents typography; that review is already independently established by the same message.
Pagination does not change chapter-title or subtitle typography. The source message's heading-related clauses are already represented by separate same-message Events.
Adding page numbers neither resumes nor changes the deferred paragraph-spacing and body-density requirement.
The pagination decision does not affect the typography or quotation-mark treatment of Mama's Hot Take sections.
Adding manuscript page numbers does not modify justified body-text alignment.
The page-number request does not change the paperback publication format or the established 6 x 9 inch trim size.
Pagination does not alter chapter-image coverage, placement, presentation, references, or selected images.
Adding page numbers does not change the requirements concerning image distortion, cropping, or pixelation.
The pagination decision is unrelated to excluding the unintended newline-marker text from the book title.
Adding page numbers does not modify chapter-image source, suitability review, or selection criteria.
The manuscript page-number request does not alter the alignment of the copyright page.
Pagination may contribute to publication readiness, but the request to add page numbers does not change the existing requirement to provide publishing-process and prerequisite guidance.
